'''Porter''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who served in the [[New Republic]] as a [[New Republic pilot|pilot]] with the [[military rank]] of [[captain]]<ref name="Part One" /> around [[9 ABY]].<ref name="Ahsoka series date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref> Captain Porter was stationed on the [[planet]] [[Lothal]] as an [[E-wing starfighter|E-wing]] pilot under the callsign [[Spectre Two-One]]. Captain Porter and [[Lieutenant]] [[Callahan]] were tasked by Republic [[Governor]] [[Ryder Azadi]] in searching for [[Commander]] [[Sabine Wren]].<ref name="Part One" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Porter was first revealed with the announcement of the [[LEGO]] set [[w:c:brickipedia:75364 New Republic E-Wing vs. Shin Hati's Starfighter|75364 New Republic E-Wing vs. Shin Hati's Starfighter]], which was released on [[September 1]], [[2023]].<ref name="IGNLEGO">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/comic-con-2023-lego-reveals-new-star-wars-ahsoka-sets|text=Comic-Con 2023: LEGO Reveals New Star Wars - Ahsoka Sets|date=2023-07-20|archivedate=20230719183056|author=Jesse Schedeen}}</ref> He later appeared in the [[Part One: Master and Apprentice|first episode]] of the [[Disney+]] series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]'',<ref name="Part One" /> which released on [[August 22]], [[2023]],<ref name="Part One Release">{{Twitter|starwars|status/1692552080764887366|Star Wars|quote=Thank you to all the fans who celebrated with us at our @AhsokaOfficial fan events around the world last night! We're excited to announce that new episodes of #Ahsoka will now launch Tuesdays at 6PM PT, starting with our two-episode premiere on August 22, only on @DisneyPlus.|archivedate=20230818152836}}</ref> portrayed by actor [[Matt Law]].<ref name="Part One" />
